x-m-el-ai-08.s.s1.line.0: Value per 1kg: A na 30÷6=5, B na 24÷5=4.8, C na 24÷5=4.8.
x-m-el-ai-08.s.s1.line.1: If you pack A first, the one with biggest value per weight, 6kg fill and remaining limit na 10−6=4kg.
x-m-el-ai-08.s.s1.line.2: B and C each weigh 5kg, so dem no fit enter remaining 4kg.
x-m-el-ai-08.s.s1.line.3: So total value no pass 30, A alone.
x-m-el-ai-08.s.s1.line.4: Therefore packing items with biggest value per weight first always give maximum value.
x-m-el-ai-08.s.s1.explain: Line 4: Na only the result when A packed first; nothing show say na the only possible combination. Packing B and C together weigh 10kg, within limit, and value na 48, more than 30. This one counterexample show line 5 no hold.
